{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: HATCHBOX ABS 3D Printer Filament, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 1 kg Spool, 1.75 mm, Gray; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects involve electronics and hardware; I have no current need for printer filament.
ItemID: NA; Title: AIRSUNNY three Legs 5 pairs Infrared Diode LED IR Emission and Receiver; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my electronics interests, but I would wait until I have a specific infrared sensing project.
ItemID: NA; Title: HATCHBOX 1.75mm Orange PLA 3D Printer Filament, 1 KG Spool, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 3D Printing Filament; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no established need for 3D printing supplies right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: eSUN 3D 1.75mm PETG Red Filament 1kg (2.2lb), PETG 3D Printer Filament, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.03 mm, 1.75mm Solid Opaque Red; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Filament does not directly support the circuit projects reflected in my purchases.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hilitchi 550Pcs 0.1uF-10uF DIP Monolithic Multilayer Ceramic Chip Capacitors Assortment Kit (550); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this assortment to have useful capacitor values available for breadboard and PCB experiments.
ItemID: NA; Title: ELEGOO 3PCS 400 tie-Points breadboard, 4 Power Rails for Jumper Wire; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Larger breadboards would give me more room than my mini boards for circuits with relays and other components.
ItemID: NA; Title: STEPPERONLINE Stepper Motor Nema 17 Bipolar 40mm 64oz.in(45Ncm) 2A 4 Lead 3D Printer Hobby CNC; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not currently have a motor-driven project that calls for this part.
ItemID: NA; Title: HiLetgo 2pcs W1209 12V DC Digital Temperature Controller Board Micro Digital Thermostat -50-110°C Electronic Temperature Temp Control Module Switch with 10A One-Channel Relay and Waterproof; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Temperature sensing and relay control interest me, but I would need a specific control application before buying.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hilitchi 675-Piece 15 Values 2N2222-S9018 NPN PNP Power General Purpose Transistors Assortment Kit; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Transistors fit my circuit-building interests, but this large assortment feels unnecessary without a particular circuit in mind.
ItemID: NA; Title: GeeBat 460pcs 2.54mm JST-XH Connector Kit with 2.54mm Female Pin Header and 2/3 / 4/5 / 6 Pin Housing Connector Adapter Plug (JST Connector Kit); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose these for removable wiring connections in my PCB and power projects, after checking connector compatibility."}
